description: This file defines the ICatalogViewModelService interface, which specifies methods for retrieving catalog items, brands, and types in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: ICatalogViewModelService
classes.description: Interface for catalog view model service with methods to fetch catalog items, brands, and types.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves catalog items based on pagination and optional filtering by brand and type.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of available brands as select list items.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of catalog types as select list items.
